title: On Tewsday the xiiij. of Iuly, 1556. The CXCIX. Sermon which is the ninth vpon the xxxiij. Chapter, and the first vpon the xxxiiij. Chapter.

segments.text: 29 Blessed art thou O Israell. Who is like thee O people which art saued by the Lorde the sheelde of thine ayde, and who is the sworde of thy mightinesse? Thine enemies shalbe weakened towardes thee, and thou shalt march ouer their toppes.
